CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   D. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   B. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.
   B. Use Stewardship over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.
   C. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   C. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   C. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Gambling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Social Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Accounts of Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
